# Issue #175: saved development cases verified

The evaluator reported no errors, 35 evidence references, benchmark_ready=false and benchmark_executed=false; split, baseline and challenges remain missing.

[tasks and oracle](../benchmark/preparation-status.json) remain `prepared-not-reviewed`; independent original-source checking and native evidence remain missing.

Final comparison of restored paths against `d0e14f6` exited 0; Git status and staged diff were empty. Review saved commit `d0e14f6`; no new commit was created.
Startup diagnostics were ok. An initial inspection exited 1 (StopIteration from extension-based filename assumptions); corrected bounded inspections exited 0 without changing files.
No product code, thresholds, LabVIEW 2024 fallback, scope reduction or readiness claim was introduced.

The Policymaker should now order a separate cross-family review against pinned originals using the [review instructions](../benchmark/cases/dev/README.md#review-next). Reuse these verification results; do not regenerate cases or print whole cases/manifests.
